LanguageData.VV_Comms_TraditionInquiry: Ask about the custom of the fairy tale books and everflower
LanguageData.VV_Comms_TraditionInquiryResult: {LEADER}: "Giving an everflower seed to a new nest and sending old fairy tale books as its attunement deepens is simply a tradition handed down from long ago. We do not know any deeper meaning behind it.\n\nAll that survives is an old legend saying that in the distant past, an everflower far larger than any today once bloomed."
